name: SN74AVC4T245PWR
title: SN74AVC4T245: 4-bit dual-supply bus transceiver with configurable level translation, 3-state
summary: A four-bit, non-inverting, bidirectional level translator built as two independent 2-bit sections, each with its own direction and active-low enable inputs. Port A runs from VCCA and port B from VCCB, each anywhere from 1.2 V to 3.6 V; the control inputs follow VCCA. Ioff turns the outputs off on an unpowered part, and either supply at ground puts both ports at high impedance. SN74AVC4T245PWR is the TSSOP-16 version on a 2000-piece reel.

circuits.title: Typical application: 1.2 V controller to 3.3 V system
circuits.description: A 1.2 V controller and a 3.3 V system share four data lines through the translator. The 1.2 V rail feeds VCCA and the 3.3 V rail feeds VCCB, each with its own decoupling to ground. Section 1 has 1DIR pulled up to 1.2 V, so it carries 1A1 and 1A2 from the controller out to 1B1 and 1B2 at 3.3 V levels; section 2 has 2DIR pulled down to ground, so it carries 2B1 and 2B2 from the system back to 2A1 and 2A2 at 1.2 V levels. The controller drives both active-low enables, and each enable also has a pull-up to 1.2 V.
notes: The 0.1 µC capacitor values should read 0.1 µF.
Either supply may be anywhere from 1.2 V to 3.6 V.

circuits.title: Switching-time test load
circuits.description: The output under test is loaded by CL and RL to ground and by a second RL to switch S1. S1 is open for propagation delays, at 2 × VCCO for tPLZ and tPZL, and at GND for tPHZ and tPZH. The input pulses come from a 50 Ω generator at 10 MHz repetition rate with edges of at least 1 V/ns; one output is measured at a time, one transition per measurement.

operation.text: Four non-inverting bidirectional buffers in two independent sections of two bits. Each section has its own direction input (1DIR, 2DIR) and its own active-low output enable (1OE, 2OE). With OE low, DIR high drives the B pins from the A pins and DIR low drives the A pins from the B pins. With OE high both ports of that section are off.

Port A runs from VCCA and port B from VCCB; each supply may be set anywhere from 1.2 V to 3.6 V, independently of the other, so any of the 1.2 V, 1.5 V, 1.8 V, 2.5 V and 3.3 V levels can be joined. The part is optimised for supplies of 1.4 V to 3.6 V and still works down to 1.2 V. The I/O pins tolerate 4.6 V.
All four control pins (1DIR, 2DIR, 1OE, 2OE) are powered from VCCA, and their VIH and VIL thresholds scale with VCCA.

The input stages on both ports are always on, whichever direction is selected. Each data input needs a defined high or low level; a floating input raises ICC and ICCZ. Unused data inputs are held at VCCI or GND.
With the part powered down, the Ioff circuit turns the outputs off, which stops damaging current flowing back through the device.
If either VCCA or VCCB is at GND, both ports go to high impedance.

To hold the outputs at high impedance while the supplies ramp, OE is pulled up to VCCA through a resistor and is not taken low until VCCA and VCCB are both up and settled. The smallest usable pull-up value is set by how much current the circuit driving OE can sink.
Up to 380 Mbps from 1.8 V to 3.3 V; 200 Mbps from below 1.8 V to 3.3 V; 200 Mbps into 2.5 V or 1.8 V; 150 Mbps into 1.5 V; 100 Mbps into 1.2 V. The part suits push-pull drivers on its data pins.

The input swing comes from the supply of the device driving the translator: a valid high must be above the receiving port's VIH and a valid low below its VIL. The output swing is set by the supply of the device the translator drives.

Each supply has a bypass capacitor next to its pin, signal traces are short to avoid excess loading, and the signal lines carry pads for an optional load capacitor or pull-up resistor to set rise and fall times. The VCCA and VCCB bypass capacitors sit beside pins 1 and 16, and OE is held high through a pull-up until VCCA and VCCB are powered up.
Latch-up immunity above 100 mA per JESD 78, Class II. ESD withstand: 8000 V human-body model (A114-A), 150 V machine model (A115-A), 1000 V charged-device model (C101).
An automotive (AEC-Q100) version is sold as SN74AVC4T245-Q1.
